title: Health check endpoints

requirements.text: A liveness endpoint answers 200 without running dependency checks
A readiness endpoint runs named dependency checks concurrently, each with its own timeout
A failing critical dependency returns 503; a failing non-critical one reports degraded with 200
Responses do not leak error messages, connection strings or stack traces by default
Responses are no-store JSON; HEAD is supported and other methods get 405 with Allow
Per-check detail is shown only to internal or authorized callers; public probes get status only

evidence.name: liveness is 200, no-store JSON, and runs no checks
readiness passes with per-check status, duration, and detail
checks run concurrently and time out individually with an abort signal
critical failure gives 503 without leaking the error message
critical failure gives 503 without leaking the error message
HEAD has status and headers but no body; other methods get 405 with Allow

notes: detail-access is uncovered: the module always returns per-check status and only gates error text (exposeErrors); restricting detail to authorized callers is the app's routing.
